008package paint.viewer.control;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.Square;
011import paint.viewer.ui.panels.SquareGridPanel;
012
013import java.util.*;
014
015/**
016 * Handles cell assignment operations for a grid of {@link Square} objects.
017 * <p>
018 * Provides:
019 * <ul>
020 *   <li>Assigning a common cell ID to all currently selected squares.</li>
021 *   <li>Undoing the latest assignment by restoring the previous state.</li>
022 *   <li>Clearing state when switching recordings.</li>
023 * </ul>
024 * All repainting is delegated to the {@link SquareGridPanel}.
025 */
026public class CellAssignmentManager {
027
028    /** Maps squareNumber → cellId for all assigned squares. */
029    private final Map<Integer, Integer> squareAssignments = new HashMap<>();
030
031    /** Stack of previous assignment snapshots, enabling undo. */
032    private final Deque<Map<Integer, Integer>> undoStack = new ArrayDeque<>();
033
034    /** Tracks whether this is the first assignment action since switching recordings. */
035    private boolean firstAssignmentForRecording = true;
036
037    /**
038     * Assigns the specified cell ID to all user-selected squares.
039     * <p>
040     * The current assignment map is copied and pushed onto the undo stack
041     * before any modification occurs, ensuring a reversible operation.
042     *
043     * @param cellId ID to assign to each selected square
044     * @param grid   the grid panel containing square objects and selection info
045     * @return an unmodifiable view of the updated squareAssignments map
046     */
047    public Map<Integer, Integer> assignUserSelectedSquares(int cellId, SquareGridPanel grid) {
048
049        // All square numbers currently selected by the user
050        Set<Integer> userSelectedSquaresNumbers = grid.getUserSelectedSquaresNumbers();
051
052        if (userSelectedSquaresNumbers.isEmpty()) {
053            return Collections.unmodifiableMap(squareAssignments);
054        }
055
056        // Save the current state for undo
057        undoStack.push(new HashMap<>(squareAssignments));
058
059        // Apply new assignments
060        for (Square square : grid.getSquares()) {
061            if (userSelectedSquaresNumbers.contains(square.getSquareNumber())) {
062                square.setCellId(cellId);
063                squareAssignments.put(square.getSquareNumber(), cellId);
064            }
065        }
066
067        // Clear temporary selection markers and repaint the UI
068        grid.clearMouseSelection();
069        grid.repaint();
070
071        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(squareAssignments);
072    }
073
074    /**
075     * Reverts the most recent assignment operation.
076     * <p>
077     * Restores the assignment map to the previous snapshot and applies the
078     * restored values to the grid's square objects, followed by a repaint.
079     *
080     * @param grid the grid panel whose displayed squares must be updated
081     */
082    public void undo(SquareGridPanel grid) {
083        if (undoStack.isEmpty()) {
084            return;
085        }
086
087        // Restore prior assignment snapshot
088        squareAssignments.clear();
089        squareAssignments.putAll(undoStack.pop());
090
091        // Apply restored IDs to the actual square objects
092        for (Square square : grid.getSquares()) {
093            int cellId = squareAssignments.containsKey(square.getSquareNumber())
094                    ? squareAssignments.get(square.getSquareNumber())
095                    : 0;
096            square.setCellId(cellId);
097        }
098
099        grid.repaint();
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * Clears all assignment and undo state, used whenever the viewer
104     * navigates to a different recording.
105     */
106    public void clear() {
107        undoStack.clear();
108        squareAssignments.clear();
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * Sets whether this is the first assignment for the current recording.
113     *
114     * @param firstAssignmentForRecording {@code true} if first assignment
115     */
116    public void setFirstAssignmentForRecording(boolean firstAssignmentForRecording) {
117        this.firstAssignmentForRecording = firstAssignmentForRecording;
118    }
119
120    /**
121     * @return {@code true} if this is the first assignment for the recording.
122     */
123    public boolean isFirstAssignmentForRecording() {
124        return firstAssignmentForRecording;
125    }
126}
